text: Ladies and gentlemen, the house itself has stepped into the ring! Hand-crafted by the owner with their own coding agents, this pressure fighter wears a charcoal rash guard and white hand wraps. The clothing rebuild closed that waist gap and tidied the hems, and three knockdown and get-up clips are in the bag. Realism climbs from 37 to 38! Just mind that ragged neck seam, those rippling shirt bands, and the garments tearing on the roundhouse. Fighting out of the front office, the Landlord of the Dojo, THE OWNER!
